title: Cover missing and ambiguous execution directories in withheld test history
outcome: Host-observed test history keeps the execution result after named-root attribution is withheld. When the runtime reports no execution directory or directory candidates are ambiguous, display location and stored proof worktree remain empty.
acceptance: Deterministic host-observed command cases for missing and ambiguous execution directories assert that test results remain visible and both display location and proof worktree are empty.
